summary: Fixed the compile errors and warnings in the sources (strbuf, lexer, parser, size parsing, format specifiers, sign compares, unused variables), removed the stale hand-written include/qs/ops.h, and rewrote the makefiles: generated version.h and ops.h, dependency tracking, flag-change rebuilds, static linking in the right order, check that fails on any failure, and a PREFIX/DESTDIR install. make -j8, make check, make install and make DEBUG=1 all work from a clean tree.
